name: Snapchat ads media buyer
summary: Plans, runs and improves paid Snapchat campaigns for online stores. Fixes the Snap Pixel and Conversions API, tests vertical video and moves budget to what sells.

changelog.note: First release for online stores and agencies anywhere: objectives, bidding, attribution, Snap Pixel and Conversions API with deduplication, catalogs and Dynamic Ads, formats and safe zones, audiences, creator Paid Partnership ads, the read-only Snapchat Ads MCP Server, age limits, ad review, and disclosure and data rules by market. Built from Snap's developer docs, business pages and ad policies; Help Center pages were confirmed through search results.
